summary: Frontend-only verification of Admin panel bug fix + layout redesign (iteration 5). All 9 admin tabs render without crash after usePagedSearch hooks re-added. New dark sidebar shell + white topbar (breadcrumb + date + Lihat Situs link) + user card + logout at bottom all render correctly with expected data-testids. CRUD dialogs open, search filters wired, logout returns to /login, regression pages (kiosk/monitor/operator) load fine and operator branch dropdown is locked as expected.
action_items: (Pre-existing, out of iteration scope) Login.jsx always navigates to /admin regardless of role, and Protected wrapper has no role gate — operators (role=operator) can navigate to /admin and see the full admin panel. Suggest routing based on user.role and role-gating the /admin Protected route.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 1082 lines — recommend splitting into per-tab sub-components (BranchesTab, ServicesTab, etc.) for maintainability.
Login redirect is role-agnostic; add role check and route operators to /operator, admins to /admin.
Protected component in App.js does not enforce role; any authenticated user reaches /admin.
seed_data_creation: None. No test rows created (dialog opened then Escape).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 9-tab render regression + new shell testids verified via playwright. Add-service and add-user dialogs open fine. If future iteration re-enables role-based routing, re-test Login.jsx redirect + Admin Protected role guard.
verified_flows: Admin login -> /admin (topbar, sidebar, user card, logout visible)
9 tabs clicked sequentially (dashboard/branches/services/counters/recap/settings/users/database/printers) — all render, no console errors, no pageerror
Add user dialog opens (admin-user-dialog visible) & closes
/operator loads with branch selector locked to 'Kantor Cabang'
